diagnosis: AVGO and CRWV lost 4.6 combined; AMD and NBIS earned 0.6. All replay positions finished flat, peak gross inventory was two lots, and requests peaked at 12/s. The immediate problem is the cost of a few completed trades, not insufficient request capacity. Replay went from +0.4 in the first half to −4.4 in the second. Live lost 3.6 without a drawdown halt, and the sole 42.1-minute Nacht window also lost money (−18.3). The current passive checks ask whether there is depth behind an entry and evidence for a round trip. Neither explicitly withdraws an inventory-increasing quote when both executable touches have already moved several ticks toward it. That distinction matters on AVGO: its mean continuation after a large move exceeded a one-tick spread, yet Muster found no stable spread-paying IOC signal. This supports testing when not to sell liquidity; it does not establish a profitable momentum taker. A quote filled by the initial jump cannot be saved by observing that jump afterward.
strategy_plan: Test one change: after the external bid AND ask rise at least three ticks versus five seconds ago, withdraw only inventory-increasing offers for up to 15 seconds. Mirror the rule for falling books and bids. Release early if both touches retrace to their pre-move levels. Requiring both touches distinguishes repricing from a spread change; using the cleaned book rather than last trades avoids bid–ask bounce. This is a prospective test of a book-based proxy for the reported trade-price pattern. Apply it at final passive sizing, so exits, shadow observations, IOC eligibility and existing risk limits are unchanged. Do not blacklist AVGO or increase lots. The edits are an unverified candidate: run python3 -m unittest tests/test_bot.py and python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -p test_maker_pull.py, then compare bot/backtest.py on cycle_004 using --strategy runner:BacktestBot against −4.0 with no disconnect. Inspect whether the veto was active BEFORE the losing entry, how much AMD/NBIS profit was forgone, and whether fills remain. Check the Nacht window and a fresh chunk before sizing up; avoiding one AVGO loss is not evidence of scalable positive EV.
insights: AVGO and CRWV lost 4.6 on 14 replay fills; the other 28 fills earned 0.6. Evaluate a quote veto by the PnL of the round trips it changes, not by a reduction in fill count.

After large moves, AVGO continued +1.64 ticks over 70 observations while AMD reverted −0.90 ticks over 56. Timestamp the first actionable book warning against the opening fill: a signal first visible in the fill poll cannot justify claiming that loss was preventable.
